description: The four voices of the Atari POKEY, each mixing a square tone with the chip's polynomial noise generators

params.text: Sets the pitch of that tone, two and a half octaves either side of C4
Attenuates the voltage at that tone's MOD jack before it is added to the pitch, and inverts it below zero
Picks the noise pattern mixed into that tone, 0 to 7; fully clockwise gives a clean square wave and lower settings fold in the chip's four, five and seventeen bit sequences
Sets the level of that tone, 0 to 15
Switched on, the chip is clocked four times slower, which drops every voice into a much lower range
Switched on, tone 2 is high-pass filtered by tone 4, which turns tone 4 into a filter control rather than a voice
Switched on, tone 1 is high-pass filtered by tone 3, which turns tone 3 into a filter control rather than a voice
Switched on, tone 3 runs from the fast clock instead of the divided one, raising its range well above the other voices
Switched on, tone 1 runs from the fast clock instead of the divided one, raising its range well above the other voices
Switched on, the noise uses the short nine-bit sequence, which sounds coarse and repetitive, rather than the seventeen-bit one

inputs.text: Raises the pitch of that tone by a volt per octave; unpatched it reads the VOCT jack of the tone before it, and the first tone reads 0V
Modulates the pitch of that tone, a full octave per 5V with the MOD knob wide open; unpatched it reads the MOD jack of the tone before it, and the first tone reads 5V
Moves that tone's noise pattern, one step per volt; unpatched it reads the NOISE jack of the tone before it, and the first tone reads 0V
Scales that tone's AMP knob by the voltage here, 10V leaving the knob untouched and 0V silencing it; unpatched it reads the AMP jack of the tone before it, and the first tone reads 10V
Inverts the slow clock setting while the voltage here is above 2V
Inverts the tone 2 high-pass setting while the voltage here is above 2V
Inverts the tone 1 high-pass setting while the voltage here is above 2V
Inverts the tone 3 fast clock setting while the voltage here is above 2V
Inverts the tone 1 fast clock setting while the voltage here is above 2V
Inverts the noise sequence length setting while the voltage here is above 2V

outputs.text: Carries that tone's audio, hard clipped at 5V, with the audio of any earlier tone whose own output is unpatched added in

notes: the four outputs are chained: a tone whose output is left unpatched is summed into the next output along, so patching only TONE4 gives a mix of all four
the chip's two sixteen-bit pairing modes are not implemented, which is why the switch column has six rows and not eight
